description: Search cached Learnosity documentation sources. Use list_docs_sources or learnosity://sources/index to discover valid source ids. If no sources are provided, the search spans every configured source. Hits that touch a lower-level API outside the golden path are withheld unless off_golden_path_reason carries the user's real reason for steering off it; that parameter is required on every such request.
name: search_docs_sources
title: Search Learnosity Documentation Sources
